A 24/7 online employment center and integrated digital platform that unifies previously fragmented online service channels and administrative functions into one system. 1. Background The Ministry of Employment and Labor has been operating a variety of online employment services, including job placement (WorkNet), unemployment benefits and employment incentives (Employment Insurance), and vocational training (HRD-Net). As a result, users had to navigate multiple platforms to access employment services, often dealing with inconvenient and complex procedures that mirrored traditional paper-based forms. In contrast, countries like France and Germany are shifting toward digital employment services that go beyond simply providing job information, using big data and AI to deliver personalized job and training recommendations. France’s public employment agency, Pôle Emploi, began a major digital transformation in 2012 and invested €455 million (approximately KRW 541 billion) over three years starting in 2018. Following this global trend, Korea launched Employment24—a next-generation digital employment platform that integrates systems like WorkNet and leverages technologies such as AI to provide tailored services. 2. Progress to Date ISP(Information Strategy Planning) in 2021 → Service Provider Selected in September 2022 → Development of Employment24 Began in October 2022 Phased rollout of key services began in November 2023 → Pilot operation launched in March 2024 In September 2024, all online employment services* were consolidated into Employment24 → Official launch completed. * Including WorkNet, Employment Insurance, HRD-Net, Foreign Workforce Management, and the National Employment Support Program. 3. Key Features: “Personalized Employment Services, Made Easy with Employment24” ① Integration of Online Administrative Services By consolidating nine separate online employment services into a single platform, users can now apply for, report, and track services in one place—greatly improving accessibility for the public. ➊ WorkNet, ➋ Employment Insurance, ➌ HRD-Net, ➍ National Employment Support Program, ➎ EPS (Employment Permit System for Foreign Workers), ➏ Youth Jobs, ➐ Youth Tomorrow Savings Program, ➑ SME Youth Job Experience Program, ➒ Youth Challenge Support Program Through information integration, the system reduces the need for supporting documents and data entry by eliminating requirements for information already held by the government. ② Enhanced Personalized Recommendation Services Based on the specific characteristics of individuals and companies, Employment24 offers tailored guidance on likely eligible subsidies, recommends jobs, training, and certifications aligned with job seekers’ skills, and enables businesses to search for and apply for employment support programs directly through their internal ERP systems—without needing to visit Employment24—by linking with private ERP platforms. ③ Efficient Service Processing Using Automated Screening and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) By automating repetitive tasks such as subsidy evaluations, mailings, and payment processing, staff efficiency is improved and more time is made available for personalized counseling. ● Key Features and Functions of Employment24 1) Induviduals ‧ Businesses By integrating multiple sites, users can access a wide range of employment services and support with a single login. Individuals can access services such as job placement support, government subsidies, training vouchers (The National Tomorrow Learning Card), unemployment benefits, etc. Businesses can utilize talent recruitment, government subsidies, training programs, and foreign workforce management services, etc. Through personalized recommendation features, users receive tailored information based on their membership profile without needing to search separately. The JobCare function offers competency assessments based on desired occupations and recommends relevant jobs, training, and certifications. The service recommendation feature suggests employment services and subsidies suited to the characteristics of individuals and businesses. Additionally, the labor market information feature provides data such as actual wages by occupation and wage gaps between what employers offer and what workers expect. By streamlining application procedures through data integration, Employment24 reduces input fields, enables pre-screening of eligibility, and minimizes documentation requirements—making the application process simpler and more user-friendly. The Policy Guide feature clearly introduces various support programs tailored to individuals (by stages of employment) and businesses (by stages of HR management). 2) Businesses By offering integration with private ERP systems, Employment24 enables businesses to search for and directly apply for employment subsidies and other support programs within their own ERP platforms. 3) Internal PES Staff The automated subsidy screening feature allows the system to determine eligibility without the need for separate document verification. Through task automation, Employment24 enables automatic online mailing of documents that were previously sent manually and links received e-faxes (such as applications and attachments) directly to the system. The firm banking feature streamlines general accounting payment processes, making financial transactions more efficient. The pilot consultation auto-recording feature uses Speech-to-Text (STT) technology to summarize and document counseling sessions. 4. 특히 손발톱무좀은 증상이 없어졌다고 해서 치료를 중단하면 각질층이나 손발톱 내 무좀균이 그대로 남아있어 재발하거나 다시 악화될 가능성이 높으므로 의사의 지시에 따라 약물 치료 기간을 반드시 지켜야 완치율을 높일 수 있다. - 손톱은 다시 자라는 데 약 6~9개월, 발톱은 약 12개월이 소요되므로 장기간 약물 복용이 필요하다. ○ 먹는 약은 모두 전문의약품이며, 이트라코나졸, 플루코나졸 성분이 함유된 항진균제가 있다. - verified_sources.excerpt: 알고 받는 비급여 항목별 가격 정보 수술별 진료 정보 안전성·효과성 정보 질환별 건강 정보 홈 알고 받는 비급여 질환별 건강 정보 질환별 건강 정보 백선은 진균류(곰팡이균)으로 분류되는 피부사상균이 피부에 감염을 일으키는 것을 의미합니다. 어떤 질환인가요? 원인균의 종류에 관계없이 병변의 부위에 따라 머리백선(두부백선), 몸백선(체부백선), 얼굴백선, 샅백선(완선), 발무좀(족부백선), 손무좀(수부백선), 손발톱무좀(조갑백선) 또는 손발톱진균증으로 분류합니다. 무좀은 피부사상균(무좀균, 곰팡이)이라는 원인균에 의해 발생하는 감염성 피부질환입니다. 원인은 무엇인가요? 백선은 피부사상균 감염에 의해 일어납니다. 진균(피부사상균, 곰팡이)이 피부의 각질층, 체모 및 손톱, 발톱과 같은 케라틴에 기생하고 번식함으로써 나타나는 감염성 피부질환입니다. 어떤 증상이 나타나나요? 증상은 감염위치에 따라 다양합니다. 몸백선 목, 팔, 다리, 몸에 동그라미가 퍼지는 형태를 보입니다. 병터 중앙 부위는 피부색이나 갈색이며, 병터 주변 경계 부위는 하얀 각질을 동반한 잔물집이나 빨갛게 튀어 올라온 모양입니다. 발백선증 가려움증, 불쾌한 냄새를 동반하며 잔물집, 발바닥 각질이 두꺼워집니다. 샅백선증 홍갈색의 문양이 사타구니 및 엉덩이, 허벅지에 생깁니다. 색소 침착과 가려움증을 동반합니다. 손, 발톱백선증 손발톱이 백색이나 황색으로 변하고, 두꺼워지며, 쉽게 부스러집니다. 심할 경우에는 손발톱이 거의 없어지거나, 너무 두꺼워지며, 손발톱굽음증을 유발합니다. 어떻게 진단하나요? KOH(수산화칼륨) 용액 검사 표재 곰팡이증을 확진할 수 있는 검사 방법입니다. 의심되는 모발, 손톱, 발톱, 피부의 인설의 상층을 긁어서 용액을 떨어뜨린 후 현미경으로 관찰합니다. 진균배양검사 원인이 되는 피부사상균을 배양하는 방법입니다. 피부 병변의 인설(비늘)이나 수포(물집)의 상층을 긁어 채취하거나 침범된 모발이나 손톱과 발톱을 모아서 배양합니다. 치료방법은 무엇인가요? 치료 방법은 의사와 상담하여 각 개인의 상황과 증상에 따라 결정해야 합니다. 환자의 병변 범위, 증상, 환자가 복용하고 있는 약물 고려, 환자의 기저질환 여부, 환자의 전신상태 등을 고려하여 항진균제와 스테로이드제, 항생제를 투여합니다. 관련 비급여 항목은 어떤 것들이 있나요? 관련항목 조회 결과 관련 항목 상세 [SZ0350000] 처치 및 수술료 (피부 및 연부조직)_레이저를 이용한 손발톱 진균증 치료 상세 참고사이트 및 출처 질병관리청 국가건강정보포털(https://health.kdca.go.kr/healthinfo/) 목록 이전글 수두(Varicella)와 대상포진(Herpes Zoster) 다음글 디프테리아(Diphtheria) 만족도 페이지의 내용이나 사용편의성에 대해 만족하십니까? 매우만족 만족 보통 불만족 매우불만족 입력
